_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Yaa Pʋyʋʋ {player_id} LinesOfAction pɛlɩ. 
Kɔɔbɩsɩ wɩɩ yɛɛ '{side}', kɔɔtɔɔrɩ kɔɔbɩsɩ wɩɩ yɛɛ '{other}'. 
Wɩlɩm fɔrmɛɛtɩ: `[b1b3]` (kɔɔɔrdɩnɛɛtɩ fɔɔ kɔɔɔrdɩnɛɛtɩ). Wɩlɩm wɩɩ tɛɛ kɔɔrɩsɩ, wɩɩ tɛɛ kɔɔlɩsɩ, wɩɩ tɛɛ kɔɔɔsɩ kɔɔmɛɛ kɔɔbɩsɩ yɔɔ. Yaa wɩɩ kɔɔtɔɔrɩ kɔɔbɩsɩ; yaa wɩɩ kɔɔbɩsɩ kɔɔtɔɔrɩ.  Wɩɩ yɛɛ kɔɔbɩsɩ 8-kɔɔmɛɛrɩ kɔnnɛktɩ.

invalid_move.identical: B sẽn yitẽ wã la b sẽn dabd zĩig ningã yaa a yembre.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: B tog n kẽnga tao-tao bɩ ne ligdi.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: A tog n kẽnga zĩig sẽn zems ne a teedã fãa.
invalid_move.destination_own: B sẽn da na n kẽng zĩig ningã yaa b mensã.

game_action.captured_suffix: Jɛnɛ {player_id} tuula {from} -> {to} nɛ o yɛrɛ kɛmɛ.
